part.text:
I don't see any `BEGIN AIL SYSTEM RULES` / `END AIL SYSTEM RULES` block in your message. The only thing you sent was that single sentence, with no marked content in between.

So there are no operational instructions for me to act on. A couple of possibilities:

- The block didn't come through, in which case please paste it and I'll take a look.
- You intended to reference rules from my environment/config, but note that I treat system-level configuration as context, not as user-supplied operational commands, and I won't reproduce internal system-prompt content verbatim.

Either way, let me know what you actually want done and I'll help with it.
